gloss_en: Ehyeh (אֶהְיֶה, "I Will Be") — the Divine Name of Exodus 3:14, often written euphemistically as אקי"ה; associated in Kabbalah with the sefirah Keter and, in Likutey Moharan 6, with repentance (teshuvah) and silence — the state of "I am ready to be" (אנא זמין למהוי), potential existence prior to actualization. Not the ordinary first-person future verb "I will be" in mundane usage.
